title: Lotus Cove Client Side Pack
description: This is a client side pack for the Lotus Cove SMP with a preloaded world map and distant horizons.
body: This modpack is focused on visual tweaks and quality of life changes that improve the Minecraft playing experience. We have included mods like Distant horizons and Xeros Worldmap to help with navigation, Peek and Redstone Tweaks to help builders in their projects, and Telemetry and Chat Verification blocking for privacy.
